name: Guacathon with Denzel Curry
desc:
🙌 Celebrate the life of Joaquin Oliver in this colorful music & art street festival hosted by Change The Ref. Explore the vibrant block party's activities and learn more about what Guacathon is all about!

🎨 Share your creativity in Paint Zone by painting incredible murals from world-renowned artist Shepard Fairey
🏀 Game up at the basketball court in Hoop Jam
🎩 Grab FREE virtual merchandise for your avatar & check out special items created in collaboration with Denzel Curry & Shepard Fairy!

Denzel Curry's concert is now complete, thanks for celebrating with us!

A portion of all proceeds from sales of virtual goods are donated to Change the Ref.

🚨 Players with photosensitive conditions, including epilepsy, should be aware that this experience contains flashing lights & patterns. Older devices may not experience gameplay or concert as intended.
